subject: Bug fixes so as to use collation order better in devtools::load_all and roxygen2::parse_package

messages.author: 4a524b7e3012fc77
messages.subject: Bug fixes so as to use collation order better in devtools::load_all and roxygen2::parse_package
parts:
Hi

Apologies for duplications - I am still feeling my way about what belongs here, and what belongs on github.

Anyway ... I have trialled some 'proof of concept' tweaks to devtools::load_all and roxygen2::parse_package which I hope fixes some minor bugs in how inheritance and documenting inherited parameters are working (as at devtools 1.5.0.99 and roxygen2 4.0.1). They work on my toy example.  I have submitted them as pull requests.  My code is inelegant, and would not be used verbatim, but I hope it may be useful starting point for a someone with more experience to produce neater fixes.

Details follow below.

The devtools and roxygen2 code is fantastic - I have really enjoyed reading it and stepping through it in the debugger to see how it works on my toy example package.

Regards

Geoff Lee

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

I have experienced a couple of related issues using the devtools / roxygen2 combination to develop and document a package.  Both issues relate to inheritance, and the file collation order for the package (which roxygen2 very nicely generates from the @include tags in the roxygen comments in my R code).

For details of the issues see :
  1) issue 261 , devtools::load_all not happy :
             https://github.com/klutometis/roxygen/issues/261
             https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/rdevtools/N3wy684ccnA
             https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/rdevtools/2TMDbDcPNA8
             and
  2) issue related to order of (inherited) parameters in documentation from roxygen2
             https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/rdevtools/KBd7X8UbqPg

These issues would be solved if :
  1) devtools::load_all updated the Collate field in the description file before attempting to load and evaluate the R code in the package
  and
  2) roxygen2::roxygenise read in and parsed the roxygen comment blocks from R files in the order of the Collate sequence instead of from R files in alphabetical filename sequence.

I have tried some 'proof of concept' tweaks to devtools::loadall and roxygen2::roxygenise to trial this, and they do solve my immediate problem.

My solutions are not as elegant and concise as the master devtools and roxygen code (which is awesome!), and have not been tested in other 'use cases', nor for efficiency, nor for other platforms (I am on Windows 7). But perhaps they will be useful small contribution as a rough starting point for other more experienced coders.

Regards

Geoff Lee
